self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Oppidan Ambush (R5): while in the party but off-field, DMG +4% per second, up to +40% after 10s; once back on-field for more than 4s, the buff decays 8%/s. Modeled at the +40% max-stack value (typical for burst-then-swap rotations) since off-field/on-field timing isn't tracked by the evaluator; real uptime during long on-field windows will be lower.

en.flavor: An intricate, opulent longbow. It once belonged to a gentleman thief who was never caught.

refinements.1: While the character equipped with this weapon is in the party but not on the field, their DMG increases by <r>2%</r> every second up to a max of <r>20%</r>. When the character is on the field for more than 4s, the aforementioned DMG buff decreases by <r>4%</r> per second until it reaches 0%.
refinements.2: While the character equipped with this weapon is in the party but not on the field, their DMG increases by <r>2.5%</r> every second up to a max of <r>25%</r>. When the character is on the field for more than 4s, the aforementioned DMG buff decreases by <r>5%</r> per second until it reaches 0%.
refinements.3: While the character equipped with this weapon is in the party but not on the field, their DMG increases by <r>3%</r> every second up to a max of <r>30%</r>. When the character is on the field for more than 4s, the aforementioned DMG buff decreases by <r>6%</r> per second until it reaches 0%.
refinements.4: While the character equipped with this weapon is in the party but not on the field, their DMG increases by <r>3.5%</r> every second up to a max of <r>35%</r>. When the character is on the field for more than 4s, the aforementioned DMG buff decreases by <r>7%</r> per second until it reaches 0%.
refinements.5: While the character equipped with this weapon is in the party but not on the field, their DMG increases by <r>4%</r> every second up to a max of <r>40%</r>. When the character is on the field for more than 4s, the aforementioned DMG buff decreases by <r>8%</r> per second until it reaches 0%.
